answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 63185 Country: India Title: Shariyat Question: How much gram silver ring has to be worn? Does Shariah give permission to wear silver ring? Answer ID: 63185 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 237/237/B=03/1437) Of course, it is lawful for males to wear silver ring provided it weighs less that 4.5 masha. If it is 4.5 masha or more than it then it is not lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
